name: code-block
title: Code Block
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A code block with shiki syntax highlighting for docs and AI chat UIs. `<CodeBlock code={code} language="tsx" />` is complete; compose `CodeBlockHeader` (`CodeBlockTitle`, `CodeBlockLanguage`, `CodeBlockWrapToggle`, `CodeBlockCopyButton`, `CodeBlockDownloadButton`) as chrome, `CodeBlockExpandButton` with `maxLines`, and `CodeBlockContent` inside your own scroll container. shiki loads lazily on the first highlight (JavaScript regex engine, no WebAssembly) through the `code-block-highlight` lib; pass `lines` from `highlightCode()` in a server loader, or `highlight={false}`, to never load it. Light and dark token colors switch with the theme. `showLineNumbers`/`startLine`, `highlightedLines`/`highlightedWords`/`focusedLines` (line specs like `"2-4,7"`), `diff` and `lineLevels` mark lines, as do shiki `transformers`. `streaming` grows the code with a caret and stick-to-bottom, re-rendering only changed lines. `foldable` folds by indentation, `selectable` turns lines into a multi-select listbox, and `CodeBlockLineActions` renders one action group on the hovered or focused line. A pinned copy button stays put while the code scrolls.

meta.origin: reui.io (https://reui.io/docs/components/base/code-block, MIT); buttons rebuilt on react-aria Button
